rules.summary: Every board and ticket call goes through github-projects-cli.sh, never raw GraphQL
Status lives on the board, complexity in a label, type in the issue type; never mix them
tokens: Never encode status in a label

rules.summary: On an SRS project ticket creation refuses without --bypass-srs; the reason is a grep-able token the CLI posts on the ticket; the hatch is the developer's
A PR leaves draft only with the required local CI statuses green on its head; the sources of the list are the workflow skill's; the skip is the developer's
create-pr, ready-pr and draft-pr work on the ticket's branch, or its one open PR from another checkout; who leaves draft is the workflow skill's
The ui label, the validation record and the command that reads it
Children are native sub-issues; detaching one never closes it
Create the labels one call per line, never several in one call

retired.reason: The label commands moved to .claude/docs/github-labels.md (the catalogue sf new points to when it could not create them), and the one-plain-command rule is enforced by the shell-shape guard (sf agents guard) and owned by the generated AGENTS.md region

rules.summary: Names, colours and commands of the labels live in the shared label catalogue; sf new and set-ui create them
Native issue types live at the organisation level and need the admin:org scope to change
Tickets follow language.tickets, never the language of the conversation
